create_StatisticsCalculator: create a StatisticsCalculator to aggregate dataset statistics across multiple splits using incremental mean and variance
accumulate_statistics: accumulate per-image statistics for a given split by calling accumulate with an image, label, and split name
merge_statistics: merge all accumulated statistics into a dictionary with std_per_channel and label_imbalance computed for each split
create_StatisticsAccumulator: create a StatisticsAccumulator dataclass to track mean, variance, min, max, and example counts per channel and class
compute_incremental_mean: compute the incremental mean of a numpy array given the previous mean and current sample count
